map.常用紧急电话一键查看，支持添加自定义紧急联系人。数据保存在本地浏览器，随时可查。: One-tap view of common emergency numbers, supports adding custom emergency contacts. Data is saved in the local browser, accessible anytime.
map.遇到紧急情况请保持冷静，先拨打对应的紧急救援电话，清晰说明位置和情况。: In an emergency, stay calm, first call the corresponding emergency-rescue number, and clearly state your location and situation.
map.添加家人、朋友或社区紧急联系电话，保存在本地。: Add family, friends or community emergency contacts, saved locally.
map.准确报告所在地址、楼层、标志性建筑，方便救援人员定位: Accurately report your address, floor and landmark to help rescuers locate you
map.简要描述发生了什么、有几人受伤、伤情严重程度: Briefly describe what happened, how many are injured and the severity
map.不要先挂电话，等接线员确认信息后再挂断: Don't hang up first; wait for the operator to confirm information before hanging up
map.派人到路口引导救援人员到达现场: Send someone to the intersection to guide rescuers to the scene
map.非紧急情况不要占用紧急线路，避免影响他人求助: Don't occupy emergency lines for non-emergencies, to avoid affecting others' calls for help
map.在手机中设置紧急联系人和 SOS 功能: Set up emergency contacts and SOS function on your phone
map.紧急联系人面板收录了全国通用的紧急救援电话和公共服务热线，支持添加个人紧急联系人: The emergency contacts panel collects nationally universal emergency-rescue numbers and public-service hotlines, and supports adding personal emergency contacts.
map.核心紧急电话速查: Quick lookup of core emergency numbers
map.家中老人或儿童突发状况时，一键查到对应紧急电话，避免慌乱中记错号码。: When an elderly person or child at home has a sudden condition, look up the corresponding emergency number with one tap, avoiding dialing the wrong number in panic.
map.自驾途中发生事故或车辆故障，快速查到 122 交通事故与 12122 高速救援电: When an accident or vehicle breakdown occurs while driving, quickly find the 122 traffic-accident and 12122 highway-rescue numbers.
map.把家人、物业、主治医生添加为自定义紧急联系人，紧急时集中调用。: Add family, property management and attending doctor as custom emergency contacts for centralized use in emergencies.
map.核心电话：报警 110、火警 119、医疗急救 120、交通事故 122、海上遇: Core numbers: police 110, fire 119, medical emergency 120, traffic accident 122, maritime distress 12395, forest fire 12119; medical-specific: national public-health hotline 12320, psychological aid 400-161-9995, anti-drug 12348, Red Cross rescue 999 (some cities); public-service: consumer complaint 12315, mayor hotline 12345, labor rights 12333, legal aid 12348, weather forecast 12121, road rescue 12122. Users can also add custom contacts (such as property, family) in the panel, with data stored only in the browser locally.
map.我添加的自定义联系人存在哪里？: Where are my added custom contacts stored?
map.仅保存在本机浏览器的 localStorage 中，不上传任何服务器；因此换设备: Stored only in this machine's browser localStorage, not uploaded to any server; therefore when switching devices, clearing cache or using incognito mode the custom contacts will not sync and need to be re-added.
map.110/119/120/122 等为核心全国通用紧急号码；部分专项号码存在地域差: 110/119/120/122 etc. are core nationwide universal emergency numbers; some specific numbers vary by region, e.g. Red Cross rescue 999 is only available in some cities, and the psychological-aid hotline follows the local health commission's announcement; when traveling it is advised to confirm the destination's applicable numbers in advance.
